name: deployment rollback
query: How should a deployment rollback be performed?

documents.label: rollback
documents.content:
# Release runbook

## Rollback

Use the rollback checklist before a deployment rollback. Redeploy the previous image tag and verify health checks.

documents.label: billing
documents.content: Invoices are generated at the end of each billing period and emailed to the account owner.

documents.label: deploy
documents.content: New deployments are promoted from staging after the smoke test suite passes.

name: credential rotation
query: When must production credentials be rotated?

documents.label: rotation
documents.content: Production credentials must be rotated every ninety days and immediately after staff departures.

documents.label: backup
documents.content: Database backups run every night and are retained for thirty days.

documents.label: passwords
documents.content: User passwords must contain at least twelve characters.

name: refund window
query: How many days do customers have to request a refund?

documents.label: refunds
documents.content: Customers may request a refund within fourteen days of purchase by contacting support.

documents.label: shipping
documents.content: Orders ship within two business days. Tracking numbers are emailed automatically.

documents.label: warranty
documents.content: Hardware carries a one-year limited warranty covering manufacturing defects.

name: incident severity
query: What qualifies as a severity one incident?

documents.label: severity
documents.content: A severity one incident is a full outage or data loss affecting all customers. Page the on-call engineer immediately.

documents.label: oncall
documents.content: The on-call rotation changes every Monday at nine in the morning.

documents.label: postmortem
documents.content: Postmortems are written within five business days of an incident and shared with the team.

name: data retention
query: How long are audit logs retained?

documents.label: audit
documents.content: Audit logs are retained for seven years to satisfy compliance requirements.

documents.label: analytics
documents.content: Product analytics events are aggregated daily and raw events are deleted after ninety days.

documents.label: email
documents.content: Marketing emails can be unsubscribed from at any time.

name: vpn access
query: Which network do engineers need to connect to before reaching internal dashboards?

documents.label: vpn
documents.content: Engineers must connect to the corporate VPN before opening internal dashboards such as Grafana.

documents.label: wifi
documents.content: Guest wifi credentials are posted at the reception desk.

documents.label: laptops
documents.content: Company laptops are replaced every three years.

name: parental leave
query: How many weeks of parental leave are offered?

documents.label: leave
documents.content: Employees receive sixteen weeks of paid parental leave, which may be taken within the first year.

documents.label: holidays
documents.content: The company observes twelve public holidays per year.

documents.label: sick
documents.content: Sick leave does not require a doctor's note for absences shorter than three days.

name: api rate limits
query: What is the API rate limit per minute?

documents.label: ratelimit
documents.content: The public API allows six hundred requests per minute per API key; excess requests receive HTTP 429.

documents.label: auth
documents.content: API keys are created in the developer settings page and can be revoked at any time.

documents.label: sdk
documents.content: Official SDKs are available for Python and TypeScript.

name: encryption at rest
query: Is customer data encrypted at rest?

documents.label: encryption
documents.content: All customer data is encrypted at rest with AES-256 and in transit with TLS 1.2 or later.

documents.label: sso
documents.content: Single sign-on is available on the enterprise plan through SAML.

documents.label: regions
documents.content: Data residency is offered in the European Union and the United States.

name: two relevant documents
query: What are the steps for onboarding a new engineer?

documents.label: onboarding-accounts
documents.content: Onboarding a new engineer starts with creating accounts for email, chat and the code host.

documents.label: onboarding-mentor
documents.content: Each new engineer is assigned an onboarding mentor for their first month.

documents.label: offboarding
documents.content: Offboarding requires revoking all access on the employee's last day.

name: expense approval
query: Who approves expenses above the limit?

documents.label: expenses
documents.content: Expenses above five hundred dollars must be approved by a director before reimbursement.

documents.label: travel
documents.content: Book travel at least two weeks in advance through the travel portal.

documents.label: payroll
documents.content: Payroll runs on the last business day of each month.

name: code review
query: How many approvals does a pull request need before merging?

documents.label: review
documents.content: Every pull request needs two approvals and passing checks before merging to the main branch.

documents.label: branches
documents.content: Feature branches are named after their ticket identifier.

documents.label: releases
documents.content: Releases are tagged with semantic version numbers.
